newsitem.title: USA: Rite Aid prices tender for Thrifty notes.
newsitem.headline: Rite Aid prices tender for Thrifty notes.

text.p: Rite Aid Corp said on Thursday it has determined the price on its tender offer for the 12-1/4 percent senior subordinated notes due 2004 of its Thrifty Payless subsidiary at $1,167.32 for each $1,000 in Note principal.
The total tender offer consideration is the offer price of $1,167.32 plus a consent payment of $5 per $1,000 in Note principal for a total of $1,172.32 per $1000 in Note principal, the company said.
The tender offer expires at midnight January 22, unless extended.

The company said that in order to receive the total consideration of $1,172.32 - plus accrued interest - holders must have validly tendered, and not withdrawn, their notes by the expiration date as well as have validly consented to the proposed indenture amendments at or prior to midnight January 14.
